displayName: Don’t allow Summary Zoom, Slide Zoom, and Section Zoom in a PowerPoint presentation (User)
description:
This policy setting controls whether users can insert and playback a Summary Zoom, a Slide Zoom, or a Section Zoom in a PowerPoint presentation. By default, users can use these types of Zoom in a presentation.

If you enable this policy setting, users can’t use these types of Zoom in a presentation.

If you disable or don’t configure this policy setting, users can use these types of Zoom in a presentation.
